reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis incorrectly assumes equimolar CoCrFeNiTi is a single-phase solid solution with high SFE; in reality, Ti additions strongly promote intermetallic phases and likely lower SFE, making the proposed mechanism physically unsound.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is detailed and would decisively falsify the hypothesis if the predicted strengthening and planar slip are absent, but the test is built on a flawed material premise.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it addresses a non-existent baseline state (single-phase, high-SFE CoCrFeNiTi) and would misdirect research effort away from the known multiphase nature of this alloy.
